A '''skirmish''' occurred on the [[Halloween/Legends|Hallowe'en]] of [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]<ref name="date" /> between [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], the leader of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]],<ref name="EGC 184">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> and a band of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]]. The Duloks had inadvertently kidnapped the Ewok ruler while raiding the Ewoks' storehouse while the Ewoks were preoccupied with their Hallowe'en festivities. Although Chirpa was bound to a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] with [[Rope/Legends|ropes]], the Ewoks [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]], [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]] found him in the forest, cut him free, and allowed him to fight off the Dulok band.<ref name="Chief Chirpa Kidnapped!">"[[Chief Chirpa Kidnapped!]]"</ref>
